title: Best Nearby Excursions from Haridwar & Rishikesh - Neelkanth Mahadev, Kunjapuri Devi & Devprayag
content:
Nearby Excursions from Haridwar & Rishikesh, 

Haridwar and Rishikesh are two of the most famous holy towns in Uttarakhand. While they are full of attractions, many visitors also love exploring nearby short drives. Within 30–70 km, you can reach places that are rich in spiritual value, Himalayan beauty, and adventure opportunities.

Three must-visit excursions are:

  • Neelkanth Mahadev Temple - For famous Shiva temple in the hills.
  • Kunjapuri Devi Temple - A Shakti Peeth known for sunrise views.
  • Devprayag - The holy confluence of Alaknanda and Bhagirathi rivers.

These destinations make perfect day trips for tourists, families, and pilgrims

1. Neelkanth Mahadev Temple:

 

Located about 32 km from Rishikesh, Neelkanth Mahadev Temple is dedicated to Lord Shiva. Surrounded by forests and valleys, it is one of the most sacred temples in Uttarakhand, Read more …

  • Best Time to Visit: March–June & September–November (15°C–30°C)
  • Timings: 6:00 AM – 7:00 PM
  • Entry Fee: Free

Things to Do :

  • Offer prayers to Lord Shiva.
  • Enjoy the scenic forest drive from Rishikesh.
  • Trek routes are also available for adventure seekers.
  • Attend Maha Shivratri and Shravan Mela celebrations.

2. Kunjapuri Devi Temple:

 

Perched at 1,676 meters, Kunjapuri Devi Temple is one of the 51 Shakti Peethas. Located 25 km from Rishikesh, it is especially famous for sunrise and sunset views over the Himalayas, Read more …

  • Best Time to Visit: March–May & October–November (10°C–25°C)
  • Timings: 5:00 AM – 7:00 PM
  • Entry Fee: Free

Things to Do :

  • Watch Himalayan sunrise with views of Gangotri, Chaukhamba, and Swargarohini peaks.
  • Attend morning aarti at the temple.
  • Trek from Rishikesh to Kunjapuri for adventure and photography.
  • Visit during Navratri for special celebrations.

3. Devprayag:

 

Devprayag is about 70 km from Rishikesh and is the sacred spot where the Alaknanda and Bhagirathi rivers meet, forming the holy Ganga. It is an important stop on the Char Dham Yatra route, Read more …

  • Best Time to Visit: October–April (10°C–25°C)
  • Timings: Open all day
  • Entry Fee: Free

Things to Do :

  • Witness the confluence of Alaknanda & Bhagirathi rivers.
  • Take a holy dip at Sangam Ghat.
  • Visit Raghunathji Temple (dedicated to Lord Rama).
  • Explore nearby villages for local culture and food.
  • Practice meditation near the riverbanks.

Suggested Itinerary (1–2 Days) :

Day Trip 1: Rishikesh → Neelkanth Mahadev Temple → Return

Day Trip 2: Early morning trek/drive to Kunjapuri Devi Temple → Sunrise → Return

Day Trip 3: Rishikesh → Devprayag excursion → Evening back to Rishikesh/Haridwar
